description:
FILED s513 (Fable, 2026-10-09 09:01) from the USER's question after the detector report (docs/detector-measurement-s513d.md): "how hard would it be to extend shimming modules down to shimming subs in a loaded file -- or just a sub -- for a CPAN module?"  RULED a good idea by the USER ("OK, good. ... add a task for supporting it and shimming those subs").

WHAT: a sub, or a prototype, that only BEGIN-time code installs (a glob-assign loop over a name list, an eval-built sub, a computed export list) is invisible to the static parse, so a later bareword call is read wrong (`_IS_VMS` as a string in operator position; `capture { ... }` dropped).  The fix shape is NOT code replacement: it is the FACT supplied in advance, in the syntax perl itself uses for that -- a forward declaration with a prototype -- in a per-module overlay file that PCL reads beside the real module's source.  The real module still runs and still installs the real sub, so every VALUE stays the module's (File::Path's `_IS_MACOS` tests `$^O eq 'MacOS'`, the pre-OS-X system; on a Mac `$^O` is `darwin` in perl and in PCL, so the constant is false in both -- nothing to decide in the overlay).

THE OVERLAY FILE (readable by people -- the USER's requirement): plain Perl, declarations only, every group with a comment saying what the real module does and why a static parse cannot see it.  Example:
    package File::Path;
    # File::Path installs these four at BEGIN time in a loop over a name list
    # (`*{"_IS_\U$_"} = $^O eq $_ ? sub () { 1 } : sub () { 0 }`), which a static
    # parse cannot see.  The declaration supplies the prototype; the module supplies the value.
    sub _IS_VMS ();  sub _IS_MACOS ();  sub _IS_MSWIN32 ();  sub _IS_OS2 ();
    1;
and for Capture::Tiny the eight `capture*` / `tee*` names with `(&;@)` plus `our @EXPORT_OK = qw(...)` (its real `@EXPORT_OK = keys %api` is computed, which is why #1509 drops `capture { ... }`).  A forward declaration defines nothing at run time, so loading the overlay (or not loading it) changes no behaviour.

MECHANISM (rule 11: no second table): WHERE the overlay lives (design it: e.g. `lib/<Module>.facts.pm` beside the shims, or `lib/PCL/Facts/<Module>.pm`; the lookup must be the module's own name-to-path rule so a module without an overlay costs one stat), and ONE reader -- `Pl::Parser::_extract_module_prototypes` / `module_import_sets` (s513b) read the real module's source today; they read the overlay too and MERGE (the overlay's prototype wins over the source's absence; a conflict between the two is an ERROR naming both, rule 12), registered through the SAME path at the `use` statement's position (#2871).  `Pl::ProtoCache` keys on the module's bytes: the overlay's bytes join the key.  No module name in Pl/ or cl/ (rule 9a): the overlay directory is the data.

THE SHIMS TO WRITE (the detector's shape 1 + shape 3 names, docs/detector-measurement-s513d.md section 3 and Appendix C): File::Path (_IS_VMS _IS_MACOS _IS_MSWIN32 _IS_OS2; also _FORCE_WRITABLE / _NEED_STAT_CHECK from the same BEGIN block), Sub::Quote (_CAN_TRACK_BOOLEANS _CAN_TRACK_NUMBERS _HAVE_HEX_FLOAT _HAVE_IS_UTF8), Moo::sification (_in_global_destruction), IO::Socket::UNIX (AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM SOCK_DGRAM), Text::Wrap (REGEXPS_USE_BYTES), Capture::Tiny (capture capture_stdout capture_stderr capture_merged tee tee_stdout tee_stderr tee_merged, all (&;@), and @EXPORT_OK).  NOT in this task: shape 2 (a displaced built-in -- File::Copy's HiRes stat/utime, Sub::Uplevel's CORE::GLOBAL::caller) and shape 5 (the runtime registry gap, #2961's family); the LEARNED-facts idea (the runtime writes the installed prototype into the module cache sidecar at install time, the extraction reads it next time, the detector keeps verifying) is the natural follow-up once the overlay reader exists -- file it when this lands.

BAR: the detector log BEFORE -> AFTER over the four populations (`PCL_DETECT_TABLE=1 PCL_DETECT_LOG=... ` with a fresh cache, as s513d ran it): every overlaid name GONE from the log (gate 53 -> the residue; the report's tables are the before column); Capture-Tiny's five failing board files (02-capture, 09-preserve-exit-code, 17-pass-results, 19-relayering, 25-cap-fork -- #1509) read row by row; corpus-diff vs main's code sha with every differing file explained (the overlaid call sites move from string/list-call to constant/block-form); the sweep (TOTAL unchanged or up), the companion --quick once, the board 0 NEW / 0 LOST (plus the Capture-Tiny gains edited in), everyday BEFORE -> AFTER + --record, the full gate; guard `Pl/t/facts-overlay-01.t` (an overlay for a FIXTURE module: a constant above/below, a (&;@) block form, a conflict row that errors, a module without an overlay unchanged) inverse-verified.  Docs: `docs/shipped-modules.md` gets the overlay section (what it is, where it lives, the readability rule, the merge rule); ir-spec unchanged (a parse fact, not semantics).  One agent session.

=== DONE (s513g) ===
Shipped (branch worktree-agent-adfc6bf5313a8a9a9, rebased onto main ae71dc4b = MAIN-READY-10; gen v2-5284): the overlay MECHANISM -- PCL::Facts::<Module> resolved by the ONE resolver under every root (PCL ships lib/PCL/Facts/), declarations only (anything else dies naming file+line), read by _walk_module_prototypes and MERGED (fills an absence; exports union; a different prototype dies naming both files), consumed at the use (#2871 positional) and by the module's own unit at its package statement; generic :tag / :DEFAULT expansion through import_sets; ProtoCache key gains the overlay md5, a FOUND overlay is a dependency, an absent one is not.  Six overlays: File::Path, Sub::Quote, Moo::_Utils (_in_global_destruction -- the installer; Moo::sification imports it), IO::Socket::UNIX (re-exported by IO::Socket's code-built import: no reading fix applies), Text::Wrap, Capture::Tiny.  Guard Pl/t/facts-overlay-01.t (10 rows, inverse-verified).  Docs: shipped-modules.md "Facts overlays", detector-measurement-s513d.md §3 "s513g: what moved", DECIDED ## s513g, session-log ## Session s513g.
Numbers: detector distinct sites BEFORE -> AFTER gate 53 -> 7, sweep 107 -> 107, everyday 99 -> 46, board 115 -> 31; every overlaid name gone, none "installed differs".  Sweep TOTAL 18740 (+0) GATE clean; corpus-diff vs 4d2fc9f0 1 of 111 (chdir.t rel2abs(curdir) -- :DEFAULT expansion, perl calls it too); emission-ab 39 SAME RCDIFF 0; board base vs tree 0 NEW / 1 FIXED (Capture-Tiny 07-stderr-closed.t) / 0 LOST, passing 2431 -> 2449; Capture-Tiny 02/09/17/19/25 compile now and stop on #3023 (baseline cause edited); EVERYDAY 114 -> 114 of 122.
What REMAINS: detector shape 2 (a displaced built-in: File::Copy stat/utime, CORE::GLOBAL::caller) and shape 5 (the runtime registry gap: Math::BigInt/BigFloat, Text::Balanced extract_* -- #2961's family); GetOptionsFromArray; #3023 (Capture::Tiny's next blocker); #3020, #3022; LEARNED facts = #2944 half (b) (#3024 points at it); overlay VERSION drift = #2944 half (a).
